title: Brothers Confrontation
next_chapter_hook: As the two wills deadlock, the transcendent gaze of the Heavenly Eye grows increasingly intense, as if the next moment would bring irreversible heavenly punishment—Chen Ji must make his final choice.

text.content: Within the Temporal Rift, Chen Tianming's remnant phantom flickers like a candle in the wind, unstable. Within those eyes, identical to Chen Ji's, ten thousand years of guilt and hope intertwine into a searing light, piercing directly into Chen Ji's divine soul. Chen Ji instinctively reaches out, but his fingertips only touch emptiness—the phantom is merely a lingering will, no longer tangible.

"Ji'er... the Tianji Record chose you, and it was right." Chen Tianming's remnant phantom speaks in a hoarse voice, each word seemingly exhausting his final ounce of strength. "It's just that your father... ultimately failed to protect you siblings..." Before the words could finish, a沉闷 rumbling suddenly echoed from the depths of the rift, as if some enormous being was tearing through the void. Chen Tianming's phantom whirls back abruptly, his expression dramatically changing: "He has come!"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji withdraws his suspended hand, his expression heavy as iron. He does not probe into the meaning of Chen Tianming's "failed to protect," nor does he wallow in the pathos of father-son reunion—his intuition tells him this remnant soul cannot last much longer, and he must seize the opportunity to gain critical information. "Father, what connection exists between the Demonic Path commander and me?"

Chen Tianming's remnant phantom shudders violently. Before it could speak, the void suddenly exploded with a rift. A figure in obsidian battle armor stepped out from the rift, surrounded by chaotic ink-like mist. That face was almost identical to Chen Ji's, only the look in the eyes was utterly different—cold, disdainful, carrying a desolation that came from seeing through worldly affairs. "Twin sons of destiny, order and chaos." The newcomer's voice rumbled like echoes from an abyss. "Chen Ji, you and I are merely two sides of the same coin. Today, I've come to keep our appointment."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Record Fragment in his divine soul trembled intensely, an unprecedented stream of information flooding into his consciousness—he saw it! Countless fragmented images flashed before his eyes: two spheres of light born from the same source, one transforming into the Tianji Record to command prophetic abilities, the other falling into the Demonic Path to become the origin of chaos. The images were too vast and complex, his Heavenly Fate Value rapidly depleting, a cold system prompt ringing in his ears—【Heavenly Fate -5】.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pressed his throbbing Brow Center, yet a faint smile curved his lips. He slowly raised his head, gazing into that face so similar yet so different from his own, his voice calm as if discussing matters of life and death: "Demonic Path commander... or should I call you brother? The Tianji Record chose me, yet chaos chose you. Interesting, truly interesting." He paused, cold light flickering in his eyes. "I only wonder what schemes lie hidden behind this 'interesting' facade?"

The Demonic Path commander slightly raised his brow, seemingly intrigued by Chen Ji's composure. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, chaotic mist churning around him like a tide, his voice carrying a hint of seduction: "Schemes? Merely wish to propose a transaction with you. You represent order, I represent chaos—we are naturally two complementary halves, indispensable to each other. Now that the Heavenly Dao is about to change, and the Heavenly Eye wishes to destroy us, if you and I join forces, we might break this枷锁 of destiny. What if we equally divided the Three Realms?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His gaze swept across the chaotic mist behind the Demonic Path commander, light flickering in the depths of his pupils. The Tianji Record's perception told him that within that mist was sealed a will ancient beyond imagination—that definitely did not belong to this "twin of destiny," but rather was a forbidden existence forcibly suppressed within the other party's body. The Demonic Path commander appeared composed, yet those slightly trembling fingertips and the pain that flashed across his eyes clearly showed he was fighting against something.

dialogue.content: Just then, an ancient yet authoritative voice rang out from the depths of the void: "Cang Yutian's remnant spirit comes to witness the appointment of the twin sons of destiny." An ancient jade slip materialized in the void, flowing with primordial script and totems. Within the jade slip, a vague figure sat cross-legged, his face authoritative yet revealing an indescribable kindness. Cang Yutian—the legendary first master of the Tianji Record—had descended through this fragment of consciousness.

The phantom within the jade slip slowly spoke: "The twin sons emerged from the same source—one for order, one for chaos—they should have generated and conquered each other, rotating endlessly. However, ten thousand years ago, someone forcibly separated you, order given to the Tianji Record, chaos sealed within the Heavenly Fate Lock—this sin remains unresolved to this day." His gaze fell upon Chen Ji, his voice carrying a hint of expectation. "Chen Ji, you inherited the Tianji Record Fragment and must understand the responsibility of foresight. Whether this person before you is enemy or friend lies entirely in your single thought."

choice.prompt: Facing the Demonic Path commander's trade proposal and Cang Yutian's remnant spirit's witness, Chen Ji needed to express his stance

choices.description: Superficially accept cooperation while secretly laying plans to probe the Demonic Path commander's true intentions and weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: Reveal part of his trump cards to the Demonic Path commander
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the chaotic will
choices.risk_hint: If exposed, it will completely enrage the Demonic Path commander

text.content: Chen Ji contemplated briefly, then suddenly laughed softly. He clasped his hands toward the Demonic Path commander and said: "Brother speaks reasonably. The Heavenly Eye is indeed a great enemy, and since we emerged from the same source, joining forces against it is justified. However—does this 'dividing the Three Realms equally' talk not sound too childish?" His tone was sincere, yet his eyes continuously swept across the chaotic mist around the other party, searching for weaknesses in that ancient will.

dialogue.content: A glint of sharpness flashed in the Demonic Path commander's eyes, as if pleased by Chen Ji's understanding. He stepped forward, chaotic mist surging with his movement: "You're more straightforward than I imagined. Rest assured, what I seek is merely an equal cooperation—we each take what we need, mutual non-interference. After breaking the Heavenly Eye's shackles, how to divide the Three Realms can be discussed at length later." His voice softened somewhat, yet couldn't hide the arrogance in his bones.

text.content: Cang Yutian's remnant spirit watched this scene silently, his ancient eyes unfathomable. The jade slip trembled slightly, as if transmitting some silent warning. Chen Ji noticed this detail but maintained an unchanged expression, continuing to interact with the Demonic Path commander, while in his heart he had already begun deducing his next move.

choices.description: Directly state opposing stance, to crusade the demon of chaos in the name of order.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to gain secrets about chaos
choices.visible_reward: Prove his stance to the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: May completely escalate the conflict with the Demonic Path Commander

text.content: Chen Ji收敛笑意，周身气势suddenly一变。warm懦弱的面具之下，一股凛然不可侵犯的imposing如潮水般涌出。"兄长？你我虽同源而出，道不同不相为谋。"他的声音calm，却字字如刀，"混沌之道，以乱为根，以噬为本。我若与你联手，与那些涂炭生灵的魔修有何区别？"

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path Commander's expression instantly darkened, the Chaotic Miasma churning violently as a oppressive aura erupted forth. "Chen Ji, do you think that fragmentary Tianji Record can compete with me?" His voice carried a cold edge, "Order? Nothing but a puppet manipulated by the Heavenly Eye. You reject my kindness, thereby seeking your own death!"

text.content: Chen Ji showed not a trace of fear, instead stepping forward to directly clash with that Chaotic pressure. "Puppet?" He sneered, "The Heavenly Eye wishes to use me as a chess piece—I long knew this. But it does not prevent me from first clearing away this unruly piece." Before the words even finished, golden light flickered in his palm—the Tianji Record's aura suddenly released, standing in equal opposition to the Chaotic pressure.

choices.description: Neither accept nor reject, proposing harsh conditions to test the other party's bottom line.
choices.visible_reward: Buy time to see the complete picture of the situation
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may lose patience

text.content: Chen Ji did not directly respond to the Demonic Path Commander's proposal, instead stepping back and assuming a thoughtful expression. "What Brother mentioned... allow me to ponder." His tone was sincere, yet concealed sharp edges, "But this 'splitting the Three Realms equally' proposal is rather too vague. If we are to cooperate, there should be some sincerity. For instance—what is the origin of that ancient will within you?"

dialogue.content: At these words, the Demonic Path Commander's expression suddenly froze. It was merely a brief moment, yet Chen Ji captured it all. "You truly saw through it." The Demonic Path Commander's voice lowered, within the Chaotic Miasma a hint of struggle emerged, "To be honest, within this body is indeed sealed an ancient will. It is called 'Primordial Chaos,' the source of the Chaos Way. I am merely a vessel chosen by it."

text.content: Cang Yutian's remnant soul trembled violently, dense warning runes appearing on the Jade Slip. "Primordial Chaos..." The aged voice carried a grave tone, "This is a forbidden object from when Heaven and Earth first opened, sealed away ten thousand years ago. I never expected it would have a day of revival." His gaze swept between Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander, as if weighing something.

Just as the atmosphere grew increasingly heavy, a massive eye abruptly opened in the depths of the Void. That eye spanned across the firmament, its pupil circulating with sun, moon, and stars, as if the entire heavens and earth were but a speck of dust within its iris. The Heavenly Eye—that transcendent will, finally revealed its existence. An intangible pressure descended, Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander both groaned, and even Cang Yutian's remnant soul began to tremble violently.

dialogue.content: "Duality of Fate..." The Heavenly Eye's voice resonated like Heaven's operation, vast and merciless, "You traitors, presuming to resist Heaven's Mandate's cycle with mere mortal bodies? How laughable." The voice did not come from any direction but directly echoed within both their souls, "This seat gives you one final chance—destroy your own souls, return to Heaven's Mandate; or—be annihilated, forever unable to transcend death."

text.content: Chen Ji felt that unimaginable pressure, the Tianji Record Fragment within his soul shook violently. In that instant he glimpsed countless visions—Heavenly Punishment descended by the Heavenly Eye, the apocalyptic scene of ten thousand thunders simultaneously descending, the grim future of the Three Realms collapsing. Yet he felt no fear; instead, at death's edge, he caught a whiff of a flaw. The Heavenly Eye said 'one final chance,' meaning it cannot directly kill them—there must be constraints!

choice.prompt: Heavenly Eye delivers an ultimatum, Chen Ji must find生机 in the deadly trap

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record's power to counter-question the Heavenly Eye, pointing out its true purpose behind the scenes.
choices.visible_cost: Provoke the Heavenly Eye, inviting more fierce suppression
choices.visible_reward: May expose the truth, shaking the Heavenly Eye's authority
choices.risk_hint: If failing, it will completely infuriate this supreme being

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly lifted his head, his eyes blazing with brilliant light. The Tianji Record Fragment manifested in his palm, golden runes swimming around him like living creatures. He stared directly at that colossal eye dominating the sky, his voice neither loud nor small yet unmistakably spreading in all directions: "Final ultimatum? Hmph, Heavenly Eye—if you truly had the ability to kill me, why waste words? This so-called 'chance' is merely intimidation masking weakness!"

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil suddenly contracted, an even more terrifying pressure descending like substantial force. Chen Ji felt his very bones creaking, yet gritted his teeth and held firm, instead bursting into laughter: "It seems I've hit the mark! You have reservations—could it be due to Heavenly Dao's laws, or because... the two of us together hold secrets you don't want anyone to know?"

dialogue.content: That colossal eye fell silent for a moment, then let out a cold laugh: "You do have some insight." The pressure slightly receded, yet grew colder, "Indeed, this seat has reservations. But what of it? Duality of Fate, Order and Chaos—you are merely chess pieces this seat uses to maintain balance in the Three Realms. Chess pieces wish to overturn the board? Let's see if you have that capability."

text.content: The Demonic Path Commander stood coldly to the side observing, within the swirling Chaotic Miasma a wry smile actually curved his lips. "Chen Ji, you are more spirited than I imagined." His voice was low, "Since the Heavenly Eye has shown its cards, we needn't hide anymore either—Primordial Chaos, awaken." The moment his words fell, the ancient will within him abruptly stirred, an aura more primordial and terrifying than even the Heavenly Eye's pressure surging skyward!

choices.description: Temporarily set aside prejudice and ally with the Demon Commander to oppose the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the stigma of colluding with the Demonic Path
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily gaining a powerful ally to jointly resist celestial punishment
choices.risk_hint: The Demon Commander and Primordial Chaos may not be trustworthy

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made his decision. He turned to face the Demon Commander, his gaze complex yet resolute. "You speak true—the Heavenly Eye is our common enemy." He extended his hand, and the golden light of the Tianji Record in his palm began to intertwine with the chaotic mist surrounding the other party. "Today we forge an alliance, but—the ledger between us will be settled another day."

dialogue.content: The Demon Commander was momentarily stunned, then burst into boisterous laughter. "Excellent! Chen Ji, you are truly a remarkable figure!" He clasped Chen Ji's outstretched hand, and two diametrically opposed forces collided violently upon contact, yet gradually merged within some strange equilibrium. Order and Chaos, like yin and yang, intertwined yet complemented each other. An unprecedented power surged through both men!

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted sharply, and a rare flash of solemnity crossed its ageless features. "Order and Chaos... they can actually merge?" For the first time, its voice carried a tremor of uncertainty. "Impossible! You are merely pieces on the board—how could you break free from the chessboard—" Before it could finish, the combined force released by Chen Ji and the Demon Commander had already transformed into a brilliant pillar of light, surging directly toward that sky-obscuring giant eye!

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's remnant soul trembled violently under the light pillar's impact, yet let out a relieved sigh: "Ten thousand years... Order and Chaos have finally reunited." Countless sealing runes on the jade slip were rapidly disintegrating. "Chen Ji, you've done well. But this is merely the beginning—the Heavenly Eye will not take this lying down, and your power is still far from sufficient... Hurry, while you have the chance—obtain its core secret!"

text.content: In the very instant the light pillar confronted the Heavenly Eye, Chen Ji activated the Tianji Record, condensing all his perception into a razor-sharp edge that stabbed toward the depths of that giant eye. He saw it—hidden in the deepest part of that pupil lay a massive formation totem, and at its eye-point stood a broken chain. And the shape of that chain matched the aura of Chen Nian—the Heavenly Fate Key slumbering within him—perfectly!

choices.description: Preserving strength as the priority, avoiding direct confrontation with the Heavenly Eye and waiting to find weaknesses.
choices.visible_cost: May be viewed as a coward
choices.visible_reward: Preserving strength to buy time for subsequent arrangements
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may pursue relentlessly

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flashed with sharp light as a plan formed. He did not resist the pressure head-on, but instead顺势 retreated half a step while the Tianji Record in his hand suddenly blazed with radiance. "Brother, the Heavenly Eye is too powerful—direct confrontation is by no means the wise course." His voice was extremely low, audible only to the Demon Commander. "We both have things we must protect. Why not withdraw first, save our respective people, and ally again in the future?"

dialogue.content: The Demon Commander snorted coldly but did not argue. Apparently he also had no desire to fight the Heavenly Eye to the death here. "You have some sense after all." He replied quietly, the chaotic mist around him beginning to condense into a dense black cloud. "This commander will remember your debt of gratitude—when we meet next, don't disappoint me." With that, his form began to blur, clearly intending to flee directly into the Void.

result_nodes.description: Neither attacking nor retreating, quietly observing to find weaknesses in the Heavenly Eye.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Seeing through all sides' cards to find the true weakness
result_nodes.risk_hint: Passive waiting may lead to greater crisis

text.content: Chen Ji made no superfluous movements. He simply stood quietly in place, allowing the Heavenly Eye's pressure to envelop his entire body, yet his gaze始终 maintained clarity and calm. The Tianji Record Fragment secretly operated within his divine soul, continuously recording every fluctuation and wisp of aura from that giant eye. He was waiting—waiting for the enemy to reveal a weakness, waiting for the next frame of fate's picture.

Indeed, though the Heavenly Eye's pressure was terrifying, it consistently maintained at a delicate threshold. It did not truly act, yet neither did it relax its suppression. This deliberate "restraint" was itself the greatest weakness. A subtle smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he murmured: "As expected... you cannot act freely. Or rather, the cost of your actions is far greater than I imagined."

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil slightly contracted, as if prodded on a sore point. After a moment of silence, that grand voice rang out again, but with几分 less pressure and more gloominess: "You are very clever, Chen Ji. Clever enough that this One has developed a heart of惜才." Its tone suddenly turned icy and sinister. "But clever people often die the fastest—you think you've found this One's weakness, not knowing that this itself is a trap set by this One!"

text.content: Before the words could finish, countless jet-black chains shot out from the Void, each carrying terrifying power sufficient to bind immortals. They surged from all directions, encasing Chen Ji in a tight encirclement. Chen Ji's pupils narrowed slightly, yet he showed no panic—in those chains, he glimpsed familiar runes, the aura of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key. It seemed the Heavenly Eye had already harnessed Chen Nian's power!

At this critical moment, an intense heat blazed in Chen Ji's palm. The Tianji Record Fragment activated on its own, projecting a hazy image before his eyes—Chen Nian's figure, bound by countless chains in a dark space. Her eyes were tightly shut, yet runes identical to those of the Heavenly Eye appeared on her forehead, continuously channeling power outward. Though the image was blurred, it conveyed a clear message: she retained consciousness, she was resisting!

dialogue.content: "Do you see it?" The Heavenly Eye's voice dripped with cruel satisfaction. "Your sister, the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, serves as my weapon against you traitors. As long as she lives, I possess endless power to suppress you. And you—" Its pupil flickered with mockery, "can only watch helplessly as she becomes the tool sealing your fate!"

text.content: Chen Ji's fists clenched tightly, his knuckles whitening from the strain. She was his sister, missing for years, the source of his guilt through countless sleepless nights. Yet he quickly suppressed these emotions. Slowly lifting his gaze, his eyes burned colder than ever before: "A tool? Heavenly Eye, you underestimate her." His voice was soft yet carried unwavering certainty, "Chen Nian is my sister, chosen by the Tianji Record—she will never be truly controlled by you."

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's threat and the truth of Chen Nian's exploitation, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Break through the blockade at any cost and directly rescue Chen Nian.
choices.visible_cost: Risk severe injury and drain massive Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Potentially sever Chen Nian's connection with the Heavenly Eye
choices.risk_hint: Success depends on strength and luck
choices.process_label: save loved ones at any cost

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He violently activated the Tianji Record, heedless of the frantic drain on his Heavenly Fate. Golden runes exploded around him, transforming into countless sharp light blades that slashed at the jet-black chains. "Chen Nian!" he roared, his voice piercing the Void to reach that dark space, "Your brother has come to save you!"

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye let out a furious shriek, its imposing pressure suddenly surging several times over. "Seeking death!" Countless chains came crushing toward Chen Ji, each carrying terrifying power to strangle immortals. Yet just as they were about to reach him, a crisp voice rang out: "Stop!" The chains actually halted for a moment—that was Chen Nian's voice, her resistance from within!

text.content: Chen Ji seized this fleeting moment, the Tianji Record erupting at full power, golden light condensing into a radiant giant sword that hacked directly at the chains' core. Amid thunderous roaring, several chains shattered instantly, yet intense agony tore through his soul—Heavenly Fate draining rapidly, the scene before him growing hazy. But he saw it—through the gaps where chains had broken, a pair of bright eyes gazed at him. It was Chen Nian, his sister!

choices.description: Bargain with the Heavenly Eye using some leverage to secure Chen Nian's conditional release.
choices.visible_reward: Potentially preserves both sides and buys time to recover
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may refuse negotiation
choices.process_label: tempt with profit, trap with scheme

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcefully suppressing his inner turmoil, regaining his usual composure. Fixing his gaze on the Heavenly Eye, he spoke slowly: "Heavenly Eye, let us make a deal." His voice was calm, as if discussing an ordinary transaction, "You need the Heavenly Fate Lock Key to sustain your power, and I need my sister—we can find a balance."

dialogue.content: A glimmer of amusement flickered in the Heavenly Eye's pupil. "A deal? What qualification do you have to negotiate with me?" Its voice carried a hint of mockery, yet it didn't outright refuse, "Speak. This one wishes to see what leverage you can offer."

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips, carrying a hint of calculated triumph: "I can help you perfect the Tianji Record—as you know, the incomplete Tianji Record prevents your grand design from reaching perfection. And I am willing to become a sharper blade in your hand." His voice carried not the slightest tremor, "In exchange, I want you to release Chen Nian, at least grant her free will—she should not be a tool, but an independent life."

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Eye fell silent. That massive pupil subtly rotated, as if weighing pros and cons. After a moment, it let out a meaningful laugh: "Interesting... Chen Ji, you truly are something. Willing to push yourself into deeper abyss for your sister?" Its tone suddenly turned sinister, "But do you think this one believes you? You're merely buying time—"

text.content: Yet before it could finish, a mighty force erupted from the depths of the Void. It was Cang Yutian's remnant soul, delivering a powerful strike at the critical moment, shattering the Heavenly Eye's lockdown on this space. "Go!" The aged voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, "Take your sister's lead and go! The time isn't right, you cannot match its power!" The Jade Slip shattered violently, countless light specks scattered wildly, yet one precisely entered Chen Ji's Brow Center—a map marking Chen Nian's location!

choices.description: Counterplot with counterplot, feign surrender while secretly orchestrating a grander scheme.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the moniker of traitor, potentially losing the trust of some allies
choices.visible_reward: Infiltrating the enemy's ranks to obtain core secrets
choices.risk_hint: Once exposed, it will be utter destruction

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled. That smile was gentle, humble, even carrying a hint of terror—exactly matching his usual waste of space persona. "The Heavenly Secret Eye is absolutely right... this fool was presumptuous." He lowered his head, his voice trembling slightly, "I am willing to submit, willing to serve Your Excellency with humble service. Only wish that Your Excellency... can spare my foolish younger sister."

dialogue.content: The Heavenly Secret Eye's gaze narrowed, scrutinizing every nuance of Chen Ji's expression. A satisfied cold hum escaped its lips. "Wisdom lies in knowing when to yield. You're far more astute than those self-righteous fools." Its oppressive aura subtly diminished, the suffocating force around Chen Ji easing just a fraction. "Since you've chosen submission, demonstrate your loyalty—slay that Demonic Path commander."

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his gaze, a flicker of "struggle" crossing his eyes before transforming into resolve. Turning toward the Demonic Path commander, his face identical to Chen Ji's own, bristling with wariness, he spoke with calculated lament. "Forgive me, brother." His voice carried a hint of helplessness, "Our paths diverge. I've chosen survival." As he spoke, the Tianji Record in his palm erupted with radiant light, a brilliant sword beam shooting toward the Demonic Path commander—yet the blade scattered into fragments upon touching the chaotic mist. Chen Ji's lips moved imperceptibly, whispering words only the Demonic Path commander could hear: "Cooperate with me."

dialogue.content: The Demonic Path commander's eyes flickered with sharp light, instantly comprehending Chen Ji's intent. He burst into laughter, tinged with fury and reluctance: "Well done, Chen Ji! This marshal misjudged you!" Chaotic mist surged, wrapping himself tightly—ostensibly raging in retaliation, but secretly playing along with Chen Ji's performance. Their "ferocious battle" shook the heavens and earth, yet both skillfully avoided each other's vitals—this act was perfectly convincing.

text.content: As the spatiotemporal rift gradually sealed, Chen Tianming's remnant shadow dissolved into nothingness. Before vanishing completely, those eyes matching Chen Ji's own cast one final glance, lips trembling as if whispering: "Protect her..." Then transforming into scattered starlight, they merged into Chen Ji's brow center—Chen Tianming's final strength, his final entrustment.

The battle concluded, smoke and dust settling. Upon confirming Chen Ji's "surrender", the Heavenly Secret Eye slowly withdrew into the void's depths, leaving behind an enigmatic voice resonating in Chen Ji's ears: "Excellent, this one remembers you. In our next encounter, I hope you can still provide... surprises." The voice dripped with confident arrogance, as if already considering Chen Ji a captured prize—utterly unaware of stepping into a meticulously crafted, deadly trap.

Chen Ji stood within the void, gazing at the direction where the Heavenly Secret Eye vanished. His lips curled into a cold, sardonic smile. "Surprises?" he murmured quietly, his voice carrying distinct mockery. "Heavenly Secret Eye, do you truly believe I am mere fish on a chopping board?" He unfurled his palm, the Tianji Record fragment gently revolving within. A system prompt materialized—[Obtained key item: Heavenly Fate Lock Key Coordinate Map]. Silently, he contemplated: Chen Nian, wait for your brother. This time, I absolutely will not let you bear everything alone again.

At this moment, a hollow, desolate sigh drifted from the void's depths. This was Cang Yutian's remnant soul, the final whisper of consciousness dissipating, a final warning: "Chen Ji... the Heavenly Secret Eye is merely the tip of the iceberg. Beyond it, even more terrifying existences loom." The voice grew increasingly faint, "Remember, the true mission of the Tianji Record... is not to foresee the future... but to..." The words trailed off incomplete. Cang Yutian's final trace dissolved completely between heaven and earth, leaving behind infinite mysteries and an immense weight of responsibility pressing down on Chen Ji's heart.
